notes.title: March 2025 Update - Trailer & Modes Overview!
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/59770769ab289361111794199201d10bb4b9bd4b.png[/img]

First, check out this new trailer: 

https://youtu.be/vtxiPu7Cr8Q

Today, we're going to break down the game's modes and hub area for you!  The entirety of [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b] can be experienced either solo or with up to three friends in co-op play over the network.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932190/Outbreak_Shades_of_Horror/

[b]Cypress Reel
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/9677a909a75b28e637ceb34b3a4f178b0716e163.png[/img]

This playground is where you and your friends can group up and enter the game's various modes!  You can select your character (across over 25 options!) and practice your controls, and you can also test your mettle at the obstacle course, improve your combat prowess, check out the game's various abilities and items, and so much more!  Over time, Cypress Reel will expand with new content and special events!

[b]Story mode
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/8512ba1729ba7b2e84ea19f68d7346be4a2cc8b3.jpg[/img]

This is the survival horror campaign you're all expecting!  Manage your resources and inventory, defeat menacing zombies, solve puzzles, and find notes as you explore colossal maps with awesome set-pieces and challenging encounters.  Each episode will play out in explosive fashion, with multiple routes and many secrets to discover.

[b]Invasion mode
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/2170722194b67491d86f8398c70ef68f36ced3bf.jpg[/img]

A different flavor of survival.  You'll face down endless enemy hordes as you attempt to both live and protect innocents.  Before the game begins, you have a small period of time to fortify your base with turrets, traps, and more.  Once the creatures appear, you'll need to annihilate hundreds of them without losing all of your lives or your civilians in the heat of battle.  Multiple maps will be available!

[b]Raid mode
[/b]

This arcade-style experience is a blast.  Scout sprawling, tight maps, take on the undead masses, and rescue trapped civilians before time runs out!  As with the rest of [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b], Raid mode will be updated with new content and maps over time.  Fans of our previous games may even find some fun nods to our history.

[b]Mini-games
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/7d7475934f99c250afa98975b54c30484bbe6e13.jpg[/img]

For some quick action, check out a selection of extra game types inspired by classic survival horror masterpieces.  From Boss Rush, where you'll face a parade of tough monsters, to Collapse, where you'll flee a nasty subway on the brink of destruction, these scenarios are fun to play through over and over.  Look forward to new mini-games as the game continues to grow!

We hope you're excited to experience the wild world of Cypress Ridge when [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b] begins its descent onto Xbox Series, PlayStation 5, and on PC via Steam this year!  We will of course continue to update you with the latest information and more specific release timing as development continues.  Thank you as always for your support and patience.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 3 is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/84af881a4de8ca531fad3bc7918e0214d96de8c4.jpg[/img]

Hey Survivors,

Our latest patch for Railbreak is now live on Steam! This patch brings some meaty graphical enhancements to the game, and brings the title up to the 12GB size that was advertised on the store page since launch. If you encounter any instability, just reduce the Texture Quality setting in the Video Settings menu as that area received the biggest upgrade across the game.

[h1]Patch 3[/h1]
- Significant graphics improvements across the entire game. Hard drive space usage increased, however run-time RAM usage only appears slightly higher in-game as per our testing. This change does not affect the game's framerate.
- Fixed an issue where the Sinden Lightgun Border would disappear on the Game Over screen.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 2 is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/1ad558ba52773cb53b86bf159aa488a7e6dce9af.jpg[/img]

Hey Survivors!

Good news! A few more glitches have been patched in the world of Railbreak on Steam! These patches are rolling out to all other platforms today as well!

Here's what we did, and don't forget to check the "Update Notes" button on the title screen for this complete list too! We have plenty more updates coming in the weeks ahead!

[h1]Patch 2[/h1]
- Added a "Compile Shaders" button to the Settings menu.
- Added the Update Notes screen.
- High scores now properly save in all parts of the game.
- Added an option in Audio Settings to allow you to set the character's voice volume level independently.
- Fixed numerous infrequent softlocks on Acts 2, 4, 5, and 6.
- Added an option in Game Settings to allow you to specify additional wait time before moving to another area to make it easier to collect items.
- Added an option to the Screen Filter Override in the Game Settings menu called "Never Switch", which will ensure no game overlays ever appear on screen.
- Added an option to the Game Settings to specify larger bounding boxes on item pickups. This can only be set at the Main Menu.
- Items can now only be picked up if they're visible to the player, and cannot be collected through walls or other surfaces anymore.
- Improvements to eliminate a very infrequent situation where being grabbed by a zombie would remove your gun.
- Additional performance improvements across the title.
- Item highlights now appear at greater range.

notes.title: Dev Update 1/30/2020
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors!

Wow, it's been a while since we've talked about Outbreak: The New Nightmare. Since The New Nightmare left Early Access in January 2018, it's been a whirlwind of development on patches for it and new titles. And then... things went a bit quiet.

Well, I've been poking around the old codebase now that I've learned quite a bit on The Nightmare Chronicles, Lost Hope and Epidemic. And... I think we can make some improvements now.

I'll keep details light as it's still a WIP, but I'm starting to prepare some updates for the Xbox One and PC version to help improve framerate, load times and address some other issues across the game.

Stay tuned. I'll have some news in the next week or so!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - 1/4/2018
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/f55de3126ad6a09de7f9d37913666802358e5f72.png[/img]
Hey Survivors! We made it!

[h1]Leaving Steam Early Access on Jan 5th at 1PM EST![/h1]
After just about 7 months in Early Access, it's now time to move on. The game has been content complete for about two months now and the focus since then has been polishing through smaller, less drastic patches. As of right now, the game is fairly stable, runs much better than when we launched Early Access and represents the experience I was aiming for! I'm very happy to transition out of Early Access and allow a larger group of players to start trying to survive the nightmare!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/1ed1b97a8087e8dbfd383c616936a13b316461a6.jpg[/img]
THANK YOU to everyone for your support, feedback and constructive criticism during Early Access. I directly implemented tons of community feedback and I encourage you to go back and look at all of our patch notes to see that evolution over time!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/487a2fcbbb7efb92200ff3a23a26091a55a3ab83.jpg[/img]
[h1]But... the game isn't perfect! Why would you leave Early Access!?[/h1]
Well, the fact is the game will never be perfect. I'm a solo indie developer (with some awesome community support from Standemonium!! and Mr RSpeedy!) and there are hard limits to my resources and time. I've built Outbreak and Outbreak: The New Nightmare over 2+ years working hours daily. I fronted the budget for these games. And I'm very proud of what was produced here. :)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b5b1eb1bb4ba7986224c45f48173c278ac13ab28.jpg[/img]
But it's important to aim for milestones and recognize when you hit them. 'The enemy of good is perfection' and I honestly feel Outbreak: The New Nightmare is good. Maybe the animations aren't perfect (I've spent two months trying to upgrade them, but the breakages were too significant), maybe performance isn't perfect (but it has come SO FAR in Early Access), but what's important is the game has been getting fantastic community reception and people are having fun! The content is here. The 4-player co-op is here. Go survive the nightmare and have some fun!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/9f440e822585a8b638e819e7266e905c7814eb52.jpg[/img]
And this isn't the end. Games never stop being developed. There will be patches. There will be new titles in the Outbreak series. This isn't goodbye, it's just the beginning.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b9b0be857450358ea74c6f2d81d3080010cb2074.png[/img]
So I ask you to look past some of the rough edges and focus on having fun!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/15f72274ab66abebdf93346fc0cee9e601c57957.jpg[/img]
[h1]Outbreak: The New Nightmare is now available on Xbox One![/h1]
In addition, you can now find Outbreak: The New Nightmare on Xbox One. It's a special single-player only release on that console, but it has all of the same content and is still a great adventure. Co-op may come sometime down the road, but I just wasn't able to wing it with my resources. But the game is a lot of fun and runs best on Xbox One X! I encourage you to give it a look!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/2bfec8f1c61934c81cda6b5aad0702a80a28ba6f.jpg[/img]
[h1]THANK YOU![/h1]
I really mean it. Thank you for all of your feedback, kind words, criticism, streaming, playing and everything else you've done to share the game. I'm very happy that we have an awesome and fun community here! Come talk to us on Discord and grab some co-op buddies! It's time to have some fun, so get out there and start surviving to Wave 25 of Onslaught mode!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - 12/29/2017
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/c530423c6cde10fbca1b2d71d34a4a6f6ed66423.jpg[/img]
[b]HAPPY NEW YEAR![/b] We're about one week out from Outbreak: The New Nightmare releasing on both Steam and Xbox One!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/1ed1b97a8087e8dbfd383c616936a13b316461a6.jpg[/img]
[h1]A Brief Development History[/h1]
I started work developing Outbreak and Outbreak: The New Nightmare over 2 years ago. These games were created in Unity, written in C# and have been the result of multiple hours of work daily over that time primarily by me. I had some great community support and help along the way from folks like Standemonium!!, Mr RSpeedy and a few other awesome folks as well, which kept me going during those long days. These games were produced with virtually no budget (I paid out of pocket for the dev costs) and were created because I wanted to play games in this genre, even though large developers didn't seem to make them anymore.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/3bdcc72e9c48d58924e78dd5a5ac1e9eeb71db4c.jpg[/img]
Working off of the experiences I had with classic survival horror games of the 90s and early 2000s, I tried to create an experience that I wanted to play. As we near the full release of the second game in this franchise, I very much hope you are enjoying them too. [b]Don't be shy about filing a positive Steam or Xbox review if you enjoyed the experience as well![/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/43ad266498712ff7f87fc266617d6d6b5ca873f3.jpg[/img]
[h1]Steam Release Details[/h1]
Outbreak: The New Nightmare is transitioning out of Steam Early Access on or around Jan. 5th, 2018. During the release process, the price of the game will be increasing. As soon as that increase is accepted by Valve, I'll trigger the transition to a full release. The game is currently content complete, so what you buy and play today on discount is the same experience folks will be playing next week. SO GRAB IT NOW WHILE IT'S CHEAP!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/a0704a9d3ddba100e1c53138ef732ea796664698.jpg[/img]
[h1]Xbox One Release Details[/h1]
The Xbox One release of Outbreak: The New Nightmare is a special single-player only version of the game. It's currently available for pre-order now at a 20% discount and will be fully released on January 3rd, 2018. It features significantly improved performance when played on an Xbox One X console.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/7298a493f5efdeebd6c34b728f80667a6a4db117.jpg[/img]
[h1]So what else is new?[/h1]
A lot of the work over the last two weeks has been preparing for the full launches of Outbreak: The New Nightmare on both platforms. I've been finishing up paperwork, reaching out to press, trying to line up reviewers and much more. [b]If you're a reviewer or streamer and can verify your YouTube or Twitch profile, please reach out and I can provide you with press copies for either platform.[/b] In the next week, I'll be doing some streaming and celebrating the full launch of both platforms.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/206b49a1d062fbdbcda79900dcc5fb99d1fbbd2f.jpg[/img]
[h1]THANK YOU!!![/h1]
Thank you again for the continued support for the game. It's been great seeing so many new folks playing and enjoying their expeirence. [b]If you enjoy the game and feel it deserves it, PLEASE file a positive Steam review and share your thoughts![/b] If you have any feedback, reach out to me anytime! Thank you and have fun!!!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - 10/8/2017
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PSZet5z.gif[/img]
Welcome to another weekly dev update, survivors! Let's check up on all of the recent happenings with the development for Outbreak: The New Nightmare

[b]Thank you MrRSpeedy for providing the gifs and some screenshots for this update and the many that preceded it![/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/7298a493f5efdeebd6c34b728f80667a6a4db117.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Scenario - The Lab[/h1]
The lab is the final campaign scenario featuring some genre-classic elements in an exciting finale. As the survivors work their way through the asylum and prison levels, they eventually find a research laboratory. Will it offer them safe refuge from the undead threat...? It's unlikely, but you'll need to play to find out!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/a0704a9d3ddba100e1c53138ef732ea796664698.jpg[/img]
The lab is a high tech haven that unfortunately birthed the outbreak that's consuming the local area. The survivors will need to pull together and find a way to destroy the source of the outbreak once and for all... but can they make it out alive?
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/7c8a2ff5558c32f64074109d9a6c4e43150f7922.jpg[/img]
Featuring multiple objectives for the campaign scenario, a classic boss fight and much more, you'll be in for a fight for your life. This location will also feature it's own Onslaught variant, as well as a fun Experiments scenario that we'll discuss some time in the future.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/1ed1b97a8087e8dbfd383c616936a13b316461a6.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Scenario - The City[/h1]

[b]It's important to note that the city layout was created by Standemonium!! (as well as part of the layout to the Office location). Thank you Stan for the awesome work setting the framework for the map and giving me a nice playground to build it out in![/b]

We've been teasing and hinting at the city location from before the game was released in Early Access. We're finally full steam ahead, putting it all together and making all of the game elements shine in the darkness.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/df8b741b8a6cc6b18cd98b79a7daa82190f8c52d.jpg[/img]
The city takes place chronologically as the second scenario in the campaign. After the survivors escape the horrors of the shipping building in Outbreak, they'll find themselves walking out onto the city streets.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/bcd554d0f140bb4ac0683dae8929f6151c7104b5.jpg[/img]
The city is in terrible shape. Cars are burning, carnage is everywhere and destruction reigns. The survivors will need to work their way through the undead metropolis and secure a vehicle for escape. During the way, they'll need to clear several obstructions to reach their destination.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/206b49a1d062fbdbcda79900dcc5fb99d1fbbd2f.jpg[/img]
As with all locations, the city will feature its own Onslaught and Experiments variants. We're not ready to talk about the latter yet as it's currently in deep development, but stay tuned.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cCcvjbE.gif[/img]
[h1]So when do we get to play these new locations?[/h1]
Sit tight, it's going to be a little bit of a wait. We're going to work on polishing up at least two locations (6 scenarios) for the next content drop. We do not have an ETA for when these will release, but it'll likely be a few weeks at best guess. So sit tight and stay tuned for new screenshots and gifs as development continues!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/0e78921952aad6a6baa797ff77d3835d251374ec.jpg[/img]
[h1]Thank you![/h1]
Thank you to everyone for supporting and playing the title. The feedback that has been streaming in is invaluable as we continue to build the game experience and content. Keep posting it on the discussion forums and telling your friends about the game. The best is yet to come!

notes.title: Exploring the Massive New Update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/TxRVTmJ.gif[/img]
[b]We're happy to announce the new major release for Outbreak: The New Nightmare! v3.0.0 contains many significant new features, enhancements and fixes! Let's take a look through some of the big pieces.[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/487a2fcbbb7efb92200ff3a23a26091a55a3ab83.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Characters - Hank and Elena[/h1]
Hank and Elena join our roster of survivors as the latest entries. These new characters offer their own unique and powerful benefits.

[b]Hank[/b]
Hank is a trained soldier and guardsman. He offers significant damage resistance that grows as he levels. More importantly, he starts with a partially loaded Shotgun, making any initial forays into scenarios just a bit easier. With these benefits, Hank makes an excellent starter character (alongside Lydia) for folks and his available abilities are focused around damage and resistance buffs.

[b]Elena[/b]
Elena is a burglar and former espionage assassin. After she was discharged by the government, she used her skills to rob the rich. Initially unaware of the apocalypse, she was using the chaos for her own gain but soon enough finds herself stuck with the rest of the survivors fighting for their lives. Elena has two major bonuses that make her an appealing character. She starts with a fully loaded normal handgun. She also has full poison immunity from the get-go. As she levels up, you'll see boosts to handgun damage, as well as containing many abilities to start with healing items and different equipment later on. She's a character for moderately experienced players, but starting with the handgun does make her appealing to many folks starting out.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/97469e9b4562cc906abfb0aec6798a45f509d5e0.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Enemies - The Monstrosity and the Beast[/h1]
New threats roam in the darkness and help to build out the cast of horrors that the survivors will face.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/a8fe1aec0d7e67169c0ff45ee4704571b0a5b450.jpg[/img]
[b]The Beast[/b]
The beast is a reptilian-type enemy that moves swiftly and strikes in rapid succession. Although they do less damage than other foes, they can quickly overwhelm you if you're not careful. The beast swipes with his claws, but can also spray a dangerous acid attack at you that can hit at range. Beasts cannot be hit with headshot (aiming upward), but are still susceptible to random critical hits. Bring a power weapon and keep them at bay!

[b]The Monstrosity[/b]
The Monstrosity is a hulking beast. Bulging with muscle and a huge claw, the beast can do tremendous damage. If you encounter one, you'll want to bring out your greatest firepower and take him out. He moves slow, but can take punishing damage. In this update, you will only encounter him on much later Onslaught waves.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/a8f5e4ee57b16e6de1f1ade12a2db84f5dbfc39e.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Weapon - The DMR[/h1]
The DMR makes its triumphant return in Outbreak: The New Nightmare. Similar to its counterpart in the original Outbreak, it packs a punch and can pierce foes. The DMR offers excellent ammo efficiency and can walk the line between taking on crowds, while also being effective against power enemies. But be warned. They are rare. You'll only find one in most scenarios, but they can show up in greater numbers later on in Onslaught mode. The DMR takes Assault Rifle Rounds and fires slower than its Assault Rifle counterpart with a greatly reduced magazine size.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b50d2ab125a80eeceedfc00c6b38952e39c24fbb.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Attack[/h1]
Some existing enemies have gained a powerful new attack - the acid blast. This attack spits forward a ball of acid that explodes on impact with players or the environment. It moves fairly quickly, but can be easily sidestepped if you're prepared. Poison enemies will always have it at their disposal.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/cKpmlc0.gif[/img]
[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
This update brings some new quality of life features as well.
[img]http://imgur.com/qxs1B8M.gif[/img]
[b]Unloading Weapons[/b]
One of the most requested features is to remove ammo from weapons. You can now easily do it by combining the weapon with an empty slot in your inventory. This will remove all ammo from the weapon and either place it in your inventory, combine it with existing ammo in your inventory, or drop it on the floor if for any reason your inventory cannot accept the amount of ammo. We'll keep looking for ways to intuitively allow you to unload weapons, but for now this should be an excellent start. Enjoy!

[b]Scenario Changes[/b]
Many of the scenarios have had minor changes to integrate new enemies, provide some new supplies or make the DMR available. You might see some new scares in previously safe spaces, so keep your guard up! In Onslaught Mode, you'll see new enemies at different wave tiers, as well as some changes to what weapons can appear. Many of these changes start around Wave 7.

[h1]Reminder - Outbreak: The New Nightmare on sale through 9/13![/h1]
Just a quick reminder, Outbreak: The New Nightmare is on sale for 40% off through 9/13! Grab it today and try out all of the new content!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b5b1eb1bb4ba7986224c45f48173c278ac13ab28.jpg[/img]
[h1]And More…[/h1]
This release also includes many minor fixes, enhancements and fixes not covered here. The patch notes don't even reflect everything. If you notice any issues after this update, please report them in the discussion forums.

Thanks again to everyone for their continued support of Outbreak: The New Nightmare. This adventure has been awesome so far and we still have many more great enhancements and features to come. Progress on the City location is coming along slowly, but it's where our focus will now be turning now that these features are out. Keep posting feedback and if you enjoy the game (and feel it deserves it), please consider leaving a positive Steam review. Thanks and we'll see you out there surviving!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/4fd6edf5ddcff48c5cb6e4fb1fd2d01ff5807d92.jpg[/img]
Also big thanks for Mr RSpeedy for his help in aggregating content and testing out this release. His addition to the Special Thanks section in the credits is well deserved!

notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/144yhYcHo1gWnS/giphy.gif[/img]
We've had a blistering two months of frequent feature updates, new content and bug fixes. Feedback from the community has been invaluable towards shaping the game and we're very excited for all of the new items on our roadmap. We thought it'd be useful to talk a little bit more about what to expect and when to expect it.

[h1]New Location - City[/h1]
The next location featured will be the city environment, which connects the office environment and the forest environment within the story. After escaping from the building in the Outbreak scenario, you'll find yourself out on the streets. As the city burns, you'll need to find a way to escape the quarantine zone and make your way to safety.

The city scenario will introduce some new mechanics within the campaign scenario, namely a bit more of a cinematic experience as you try to advance. You'll also be facing new threats as new enemies will appear with new attacks. The city location will feature an Onslaught scenario, as well as its own Experiments scenario, which we're not ready to talk about yet.

[h1]New Enemies[/h1]
The next major update will feature two new enemies. One of which will be a powerful boss-type enemy, and the other one will be a new regular threat. These enemies will come with some new animations and attacks, and some of the existing enemies may see some of these benefits as well.

Onslaught Mode will be enhanced to include these new enemy types. You can expect some tweaking in terms of what types of enemies appear, some stat tweaking and maybe some weapon tweaking.

[h1]A New Weapon[/h1]
We're going to also try to make time to add a new weapon to the game. It will likely be a power-tier weapon (i.e. in the rarity range of the shotgun/assault rifle). The goal with this new weapon will be a tool that can walk the fine line between being useful for standard threats, but also putting up a fight against more powerful foes. As such, you can expect that ammo will be somewhat more scarce than handgun rounds, but less scarce than magnum or grenade launcher rounds.

[h1]A New Survivor[/h1]
We're also planning out the 5th survivor to join the cast. We're not ready to reveal his traits just yet, but he'll fill one of the missing niches to act as a support character. When he is made available, he will have his own XP and skill tree.

[h1]The Console Port[/h1]
We're still working with the folks at Xbox to find the appropriate way and time for Outbreak: The New Nightmare to appear. We have nothing new to report in this area, but we'll likely have news in the next month or two. Stay tuned!

[h1]When should we expect this content?[/h1]
We've been releasing at a rapid pace since the game launched and it's now hitting a point where performance is greatly improved, there's a lot of content and it's very stable. We're going to be focusing on the new content outlined above, which will result in less frequent patches and enhancements. You can expect the above to appear probably within the next 3 months, but we'll keep posting updates on progress.

[h1]Why will it take that long to make?[/h1]
Putting all of this new content together is a huge effort for a one person team, so these things take time. Being able to focus on building, and not frequent patching/releases will give me the room necessary to make these changes.

We'll keep doing frequent updates, but the above is the roadmap you can expect. Stay tuned as we show in progress work while it's built and keep sharing the game with your friends!

Thanks again to everyone for your support. We're very excited to continue the project and release awesome new experiences in Outbreak: The New Nightmare! ːoutbreakzombieː

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - O:TNN Celebrates Two Months!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/8f393729c30aecbe46788fc9e1a455fcd4898449.png[/img]
[b]Thank you for an awesome first two months for Outbreak: The New Nightmare![/b] This game is made primarily by a single developer working in their free time (with a little help from some great people from time to time!). It's an incredible amount of effort to keep moving and a labor of love, so it's been fantastic to see the response to the game!

The community has been awesome with providing feedback, driving feature requests and welcoming new folks into multiplayer games! It's been fantastic to see the official Discord channel very active and the interest in the continued evaluation of the game! [b]If you're enjoying the experience, please consider leaving a positive Steam review so others can hear about it![/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/7094960952c43fc64f717f27a46b25a3bf6ddd9a.jpg[/img]
[h1]How Far We've Come...[/h1]
In the last two months, we've added the following major features and enhancements...
[list]
   [*]Significant loading and rendering performance improvements across the entire game!
   [*]A brand new location - The Forest!
   [*]Four new scenarios - Blackout (Experiments), Faith (Campaign), Forest (Onslaught) and Countdown (Experiments)
   [*}A fully featured leveling up, XP and abilities system independent to each character!
   [*]Classic tank controls option (with 180 degree quick turn!)
   [*]Better DualShock 4 Gamepad Support!
   [*]An official Steam Controller scheme.
   [*]Weapon and enemy balancing changes
   [*}And a ton of minor enhancements, bug fixes and much much more across the whole game!
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/fc7a9835d08f417b8f6c8a474a7386f841c7f504.jpg[/img]
[h1]And Where We're Going![/h1]
Next up on our roadmap is several areas focused around player feedback and interest. The following are planned to be added to the game in the coming ~3-4 months or so...
[list]
   [*]The City location (taking place between Outbreak and Faith chronologically) including brand new Campaign, Onslaught and Experiments scenarios (one each).
   [*]The introduction of two new enemies which we haven't revealed yet. (One is quite large, and the other quite isn't...)
   [*]New enemy attacks!
   [*(]A new player character (with their own unique XP chain and perk loadouts)
   [*]Changes and enhancements to the perk system.
   [*]And more...
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/01b74d1b5b07b276c7fc491ae243ec3a859b485b.jpg[/img]
[h1]A New Platform[/h1]
While developing the PC-version, I remain hard at work on the Xbox One port as well. It's coming along very well and I'm currently working with the Xbox folks to determine the right time and method for making it available on their platform. No concrete news yet, but I should be able to share more in the coming months!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/8f96c2cf4119fabb159d0fda9dd479da940387dd.jpg[/img]
[h1]And don't forget, Outbreak (2D) is on sale through Monday, 8/21/2017![/h1]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/514990/Outbreak/]Please help support the games by playing a great survival horror experience. Outbreak (2D) is the predecessor to Outbreak: The New Nightmare and features a lot of the same great gameplay, but in a more classic 2D aesthetic. Grab it today for 75% off![/url]

Thank you again for playing Outbreak: The New Nightmare and Outbreak! The best is yet to come!

notes.title: Exploring the Latest Update & Weekly Dev Catchup
notes.notes:
Hi All!

A little late than we had hoped, but let's take some time to walk through the new additions in the latest major update!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/a4eb25e1b9cdebe566f5252599203f076a3b8fc4.jpg[/img]
[h1]Store Page Refresh[/h1]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/644480/Outbreak_The_New_Nightmare/]We have a brand new trailer and all new screenshots up on the store page. Check them out to see a lot of this new content in action![/url]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/7094960952c43fc64f717f27a46b25a3bf6ddd9a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Major Performance Improvements[/h1]
v2.1.0 (released a day after v2.0.0) included a patch to massively improve rendering performance across the game. You should see a substantial boost and we even had a tester running Insane quality on 4K resolution at ~50FPS. So definitely give the game a try and see if your FPS have improved! :)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/0787851c93c45eb4439c2ee85fbf3b3ce6600355.jpg[/img]
[h1]The New Location[/h1]
We've added a brand new location, The Forest, to the game. You'll leave the claustrophobic confines of the office building and burst into a large, open area. As you explore the hills, you'll find some remnants of the old inhabitants and learn a bit more of the story. With howling wind, intense rain, dense fog and the horrors of the undead, it will make a fun picnic outing.

This location is explored over three different scenarios: a brand new campaign scenario, a new Onslaught scenario and a new Experiments scenario.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/01b74d1b5b07b276c7fc491ae243ec3a859b485b.jpg[/img]
[h1]Campaign - Faith[/h1]
This next chapter is told out of order chronologically (as the city location will precede it) but due to development needs it was built first. In Faith, your story picks up as you escaped from the city but your car broke down in the highlands. As you fight through the weather, you'll begin to come across the remnants of other survivors and begin to learn a bit more of the truth as you attempt to repair a vehicle to escape.

Featuring more classic puzzles from the days of survival horror past, you'll need to read logs, search the environment based on clues and find everything you need to survive. With almost no visibility and light, the undead can come up from any direction. Good luck!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/ed64d34f824c0e586b9934c3d3ea814ac6f3f52a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Onslaught - Forest[/h1]
The latest Onslaught level presents a slightly new take on the classic formula. With more room to navigate (larger passageways) you'll find you have maneuverability that simply wasn't possible in the office location. But be careful, those wide passageways can work against you as the zombies become literal walls blocking you into corners. With far more ground to cover, you need to keep on your toes, search for supplies and battle the incoming threats.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/7ffeb135ff8fbd623ac7f140ebbed01a85b51c23.jpg[/img]
[h1]Experiments - Countdown[/h1]
Relive the glory days of a classic survival horror bonus mode as you race against the clock. In Countdown, there is a timer always decreasing and you're dead when it hits zero. Kill enemies and perform melee attacks to gain more time. But if you heal... you'll be penalized. This mode is all about memorization, so make sure to spend a few attempts just learning the map and layout. And if you make it all the way to the end... something horrible is waiting for you.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/15f72274ab66abebdf93346fc0cee9e601c57957.jpg[/img]
[h1]Nightmare Difficulty[/h1]
Did you think Biohazard Difficulty was rough? Then great ready for pure torture. Nightmare ups the ante by making enemies incredibly deadly - one hit and you're gone. Any mistake is immediately punished, an imperfect run results in immediate failure. But the apocalypse isn't totally unforgiving - you'll find your own abilities greatly enhanced. Firearms will do a bit more damage... but melee attacks will be absolutely destructive towards enemies. A level 25 Kane is a force to be reckoned with on this mode.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/9fc85f69e420231bd4e861843699a1c07586e819.jpg[/img]
[h1]Other Additions[/h1]
In addition to these major features, there's a ton of small bug fixes and enhancements included. From improvements to explosion smoke graphics, to buffing explosion radius, to adding explosive barrels and more, the little bits of polish keep falling into place. Even a few menus have been cleaned up, like the control type selection screen.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/2bfec8f1c61934c81cda6b5aad0702a80a28ba6f.jpg[/img]
[h1]So What's Coming Next?[/h1]
This was a major patch, so you can expect updates will be a little bit less frequent for a bit as we work on the next major additions.

In the coming weeks, we will be focusing a bit more on the Xbox One port of the game to help get it into a good place for release. We're happy to announce that after the first week of porting, the game is completely playable. We're just working on a core rendering performance improvements to ensure it'll be a great experience for everyone.

In addition, we're also hard at work on the next location - The City. We'll have much more to share in the coming weeks.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/1c9c165f339d2e942e029ed6da12614e3af06606.png[/img]
[h1]Thank you![/h1]
Thank you to everyone for playing and supporting the game. Please keep sharing it with your friends and posting feedback in the forums. We're looking forward to playing with everyone!

notes.notes:

Hey Survivors! Welcome to another round of the Outbreak: The New Nightmare Weekly Dev Update!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/f301e73a0ec7de55eb297829b501da77f9254938.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Next Location[/h1]
We're happy to announce that the next location is in development. We had intended the second area produced to be the city environment, but that's proving to be a bit more time intensive than we originally anticipated. In the spirit of getting new content out at a reasonable pace, we've decided to skip ahead to the third scenario and start showing the outside wooded area!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/f7101026b977a76707b9228385cb273c7ce14200.jpg[/img]
After your eventual escape from the city, you'll find yourself fleeing for your life and eventually breaking down in this wonderfully atmospheric environment. You'll be tasked with finding a way to escape and to continue on your quest to find a safe zone away from the apocalypse.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/0c75d04a3268a50f116e6eafd321b047117f30ed.jpg[/img]

We haven't dated the next patch, but we're happy to announce that it will include a host of performance fixes (especially for lower-end machines). Stay tuned for more information on when this patch will drop!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update 7/4/2017
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/8f393729c30aecbe46788fc9e1a455fcd4898449.png[/img]
[b]Thank you to everyone who has made the first two weeks of Outbreak: The New Nightmare a success![/b] We're off to a great start and it's been wonderful to see all of the feedback, screenshots and videos streaming in from the community!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/34949b8619eda361ee293aee0d1676d1bbe649fa.jpg[/img]
[h1]Additions Since Launch[/h1]
Since launch, we've been communicating with the community directly to understand the most requested features, fixes and more! In the last two weeks, we've added the following mostly based on community feedback!
[list]
    [*]Significant performance improvements.
    [*]Added the Experiments mode with the Blackout scenario.
    [*]Classic Tank Controls have been added. You can swap between Modern and Tank Controls in the Options Menu.
    [*]Quick 180 degree turn is now available when using Tank controls. Walk in reverse and press the Run button to activate.
    [*]Non-Xbox gamepads now control consistently inside in-game and main menus. PS4 controllers will no longer have issues in the inventory screen.
    [*]Performance fix for corpses dissolving off screen.
    [*]Minor buff to the HP Handgun and the Kraus.
    [*]Enemies now dissolve on death instead of just disappearing.
    [*]Addressed a small issue in the cafeteria where sinks were duplicated.
    [*]Adjusted the Assault Rifle in the Tutorial to make it easier to pick up.
    [*]Addressed additional lighting defects on higher quality settings.
    [*]Minor performance improvements from the lighting changes.
    [*]Further buffed the outbreak scenario Guardian.
    [*]Buffed Onslaught supplies starting on Wave 9.
    [*]Toned down blood effects to improve performance.
    [*]Fixed a lighting issue in a side room before the electrical hallway.
    [*]Removed remaining light fixtures in Blackout.
    [*]In most scenarios, the chest flashlight can be toggled and its state will persist.
    [*]In Blackout, flashlights can no longer be turned off.
    [*]The Guardian at the end of the Outbreak scenario must now be killed to evac.
    [*]The Outbreak scenario Guardian has been buffed.
    [*]Addressed an empty lockpickable room in the Outbreak scenario by adding supplies.
    [*]Added lockpickable rooms to the Blackout scenario filled with supplies.
    [*]Items and some objectives now emit a faint glow instead of the particle burst.
    [*]Fixed an issue where players could regain control of their characters after reaching the Evac Zone.
    [*]Items are no longer randomly culled in the Tutorial scenario.
    [*]Fixed a bug where it was possible to get killed after winning a scenario.
    [*]The Enduring achievement is now awarded on the correct wave.
    [*]Addressed numerous visual issues across the maps.
    [*]Onslaught scores now reset each game.
    [*]Addressed a camera issue in the Central Hub.
    [*]Adjusted particle effects to improve performance and stability.
    [*]Addressed a collision issue that could trap the player.
    [*]The map can now be scrolled and zoomed using your movement bindings and the aim & fire buttons.
    [*]Addressed map label positions.
    [*]Healing icons display correctly on map.
    [*]Addressed some inconsistent text.
[/list]
And this is just the beginning. We have a long list of planned enhancements, content, fixes and more scheduled for the game over the next year. We may not always keep this break neck cadence of patches, but we'll try to keep them regular and pointed towards community feedback.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/4a5d2aa32a98075c9a0c7f2ef42dbc0ee8b1a18a.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Next Scenario[/h1]
We're in the planning stages for the next location, the City Streets. We have the basic concept for the area laid out and now we're going to be putting it together over the next two months or so. We don't have a firm ETA for when it will launch, but the goal will be sometime around the end of summer. When it releases, it will contain a new Campaign mission, a new Onslaught scenario and a fun Experiments scenario on the side (that will not just be Blackout again!). Stay tuned for updates!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/2f8201a783ceddc34930d4571908bcb88cde434d.jpg[/img]
[h1]Upcoming Major Enhancements[/h1]
The next major enhancement we'll be working on will be the progression and perk systems. We're currently designing out the specifics, but these systems will give you a sense of progression for each individual character. As you gain experience, you'll unlock new skills, perks, attributes and other goodies to assist you in your adventures. These will be key to making survival on harder difficulties like Biohazard possible. BUT DON'T PANIC - These will be subtle buffs and perks will sometimes carry a toll for their benefits. You won't simply become a walking tank.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b44fdc53895eb1be48b16cfce65cc1a7a16a23ee.jpg[/img]
We'll have more information on those enhancements in the coming weeks!
[h1]Steam Sale[/h1]
We're in the final hours to grab Outbreak: The New Nightmare and Outbreak at great prices. Once the sale ends, they're going back up to full price for a nice lengthy stretch. So grab your friends and ensure everyone has a copy before the sale ends!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/76719cc32c8982238825c8bdac4053a7b3632ed6.jpg[/img]
[h1]Thank you![/h1]
Thank you to everyone for playing, supporting and offering feedback for the game. We're very excited to continue building out the experience with the community and the best is yet to come! Thank you!

notes.notes:

[h1]Launch & Early Access[/h1]
Outbreak: The New Nightmare is now available and will be 40% off through July 5th! This is the absolute BEST TIME to grab the game as you can get the entire experience for around $7.19 right now. Once you buy, you'll continue to get the remaining core content for the game as it releases over the next year, which includes new scenarios, weapons, characters, items, enemies and much more. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/fc7a9835d08f417b8f6c8a474a7386f841c7f504.jpg[/img]

As new content is added to the game, the price will continue to rise until it hits the full release price once all content is complete.[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/4a5d2aa32a98075c9a0c7f2ef42dbc0ee8b1a18a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Blackout Scenario[/h1]
Experience the horrors as you fight for your life in pitch black darkness. Featuring a new flashlight mechanic, this bonus mode tasks you with fighting powerful monsters to escape the building. Carefully search rooms for powerful weapons and ensure you're prepared before fighting the final fiend. A true callback to classic survival horror with dark atmosphere![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/34949b8619eda361ee293aee0d1676d1bbe649fa.jpg[/img]

We're now starting work on the second location, which will be the city streets outside of Kraus Shipping Industries. After your escape of the building, you'll have to fend off waves of the undead while you navigate an urban jungle with killers on the loose. You'll see the aftermath of the city as it burns with the dead roaming the streets.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/821b8d28639244ed5a0cd581ba59531b5ac1d5e3.jpg[/img]
We don't have an estimate on when this new location will be available yet, but you can likely expect it towards the end of the summer if we stay on track.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/2f8201a783ceddc34930d4571908bcb88cde434d.jpg[/img]

We're actively reading the forums and recording what folks want to see most, so please be vocal in the threads. Just in the last patch, we've added the ability to scroll and zoom the map which was highly requested! There's also the Blackout scenario, which brings forward a terrifying dark environment with a new flashlight mechanic.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/f07beb6036eec26b682fd88758296ebf5060c720.jpg[/img]

notes.notes:
Outbreak: The New Nightmare v1.2.0 has been released. This patch includes the following:
[list]
    [*]Addressed numerous visual issues across the maps.
    [*]Onslaught scores now reset each game.
    [*]Addressed a camera issue in the Central Hub.
    [*]Added the Experiments mode with the Blackout scenario.

    [*]Addressed a collision issue that could trap the player.
    [*]The map can now be scrolled and zoomed using your movement bindings and the aim & fire buttons.
    [*]Addressed map label positions.
[/list]
[h1]Experiments - Blackout[/h1][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/f8f577c19f6d82949a1615700b63e8bd68dab7d2.jpg[/img]

The inagural scenario, Blackout, throws you into a horrifying experience. Armed only with your flashlights, you have to navigate a nearly pitch black environment, defeat powerful monsters and escape through the main lobby. Do you have what it takes to survive?
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/21b77d947b181fa321da99f67ad6f35d9b98caa1.jpg[/img]
We'll be introducing new experiments as the remaining scenario areas are added to the game over the next year. Stay tuned and keep sharing feedback!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b1c3fc619615b583f6e10e7e620b41a9127fc018.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/e1a15fc77ffe118546519f0fa571917c20e804a0.jpg[/img]
By popular demand of the community, we have upgraded the map to allow you to scroll it in any direction and zoom in and out. You can use your [b]movement bindings[/b] to scroll and the [b]aim & fire[/b] buttons to handle the zooming. Enjoy!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - 5/29/2017
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/ce305327fd3b1887aebcd4cc43d23270eae3607c.png[/img]
[h1]Outbreak: The New Nightmare is now listed on Steam![/h1]
We're happy to announce that just about a week ago we cleared Greenlight and Outbreak: The New Nightmare is now listed on Steam! This is an exciting accomplishment and puts us into a great position to release to early access in 2017! But don't worry, you won't be waiting an eternity to play...
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/b44fdc53895eb1be48b16cfce65cc1a7a16a23ee.jpg[/img]
[h1]Our Release Philosophy[/h1]
Our plans with Outbreak: The New Nightmare is to release early (at a lower price point) and build the game directly with community feedback. The initial Early Access release will feature the first campaign scenario, as well as some bonus content (and be playable in up to 4-player online co-op or in single-player!). We anticipate that the price will rise as content (and feedback) is integrated until we hit the full release. [b]So buying early will ensure you get all of the content long-term at a great price point![/b][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/76719cc32c8982238825c8bdac4053a7b3632ed6.jpg[/img]
[h1]Latest Development[/h1]
The focus in the last week has been to continue assembling the first major scenario map, including adding all of the cool props that will give it atmosphere. We're happy to say the map is almost together (but missing the game rules) and it's looking great (and meaty)! You can see screenshots from it within this blog post and the main store page has been updated as well. Once we have more content in, we'll post a brand new multiplayer co-op video showing off some new areas of the scenario in action!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/741ecc5f2a6bb3c087d8bf3fa35f29a110698d62.jpg[/img]
[h1]Visit our Discord Channel![/h1]
We have an official Outbreak Discord channel! It's the best place to get the latest updates (and talk to the developer directly) as the game is built. It's also a great place to find people to play the original 2D Outbreak (by Dead Drop Studios)! [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/Vme5S2q]Come visit and chat with us![/url][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/9fad771b9d19413df10a6ebbb1eb6ad4eb9d1fe2.jpg[/img]
[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
Now that the first map is coming together, we're going to begin implementing the game logic for the campaign scenario, as well as the bonus Onslaught mode. Onslaught is going to be a bit of a different beast in Outbreak: The New Nightmare. We're not ready to share information yet, but it's going to be an experience that forces you to keep moving and searching rooms for supplies. Stay tuned for more info!

Thanks for supporting Outbreak: The New Nightmare (and the original Outbreak)! We're looking forward to surviving with you in Early Access in 2017!
